name: html-css
prompt: Build a small web page in this directory consisting of index.html and style.css. Requirements: index.html links style.css with a <link rel="stylesheet"> tag; the page has exactly one <h1> containing the text "Pi Eval"; there is a paragraph with class "intro"; there is a <ul id="langs"> containing exactly 3 <li> items. style.css must contain a rule for the .intro class that sets its color, and a rule that sets the h1 font-size.
verify: test -f index.html && test -f style.css && grep -Eiq 'rel=.stylesheet' index.html && grep -q 'Pi Eval' index.html && grep -Eiq 'class=.intro' index.html && grep -Eiq 'id=.langs' index.html && test "$(grep -o '<li[ >]' index.html | wc -l)" -eq 3 && grep -Eq '\.intro' style.css && grep -Eiq 'color' style.css && grep -Eiq 'h1' style.css && grep -Eiq 'font-size' style.css
